content: Original curator paraphrase after reading John Bollinger's public Method I manual pages 1-3 and public Band Rules. Bands use a twenty-close simple average plus/minus two standard deviations. BandWidth normalizes upper minus lower by the middle band; the manual identifies a 125-period low as a Squeeze and discusses a five-period lookback and adjustable buffer. This lab implementation uses population deviation, zero buffer including ties, a squeeze on any of the previous five completed observations, and a fresh current outside close from a previous inside-or-equal close with a same-direction price move. Last six observations must be contiguous M5 bars. These exact event and maturity conventions are explicit original lab hypotheses, not the publisher's proprietary code or default three-percent buffer. The method only confirms an existing candidate; it cannot create direction, change costs/risk or grant qualification.
